The other variants, 22K, 21K, 18K, and 14K, were trading slightly higher at Dh467, Dh447.75, Dh383.75, and Dh299.25, respectively. Globally, spot gold was trading at $4,178.4 per ounce, gaining 0.42 per cent as of 9:17am UAE time. Silver was trading at $57.63 per ounce, gaining 1.46 per cent. title: Road towards Dubai to be temporarily closed for Etihad Rail work
summary: As work on the UAE’s national rail service gains steam, a road towards Dubai will be temporarily closed for a short period from tomorrow, October 20, until October 27. Etihad Rail posted the news on social media, saying that due to the ongoing infrastructure works, the exit from Maliha Road towards Dubai (Emirates Road) will be temporarily closed between midnight and 4am. The road will be affected for one week. Etihad Rail launched its first trip ferrying passengers on September 29. Hundreds of bodies have been discovered since 2023 at the cult base inland from the Kenyan beach resort of Malindi, in what became known as the “Shakahola Forest Massacre”. Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie is alleged to have incited his acolytes to starve to death in order to “meet Jesus”. Mackenzie and his associates pleaded not guilty to 191 counts of murder in 2024.

title: World : Russian, Iranian Foreign Ministers Hold Talks In Tehran
summary: ISTANBUL, Oct 19 (Bernama-Anadolu) -- Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov met his Iranian counterpart Abbas Araghchi in Tehran on Monday, with diplomatic delegations from both countries beginning talks immediately afterward, Iran’s state broadcaster IRIB reported, Anadolu Ajansi reported.

title: World : French PM Urges Targeted Curfews After Violent Weekend Protests
summary: PARIS, Oct 19 (Bernama-Xinhua) -- French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said Monday that partial curfews would be introduced in some areas starting Monday evening following incidents of looting during weekend protests, Xinhua reported.

title: World : Singapore Vows Tougher Legal Action Against Companies Linked To Haze
summary: By Anas Abu Hassan SINGAPORE, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- Singapore has vowed to use all available legal and regulatory measures against companies potentially linked to the haze that has blanketed several Southeast Asian countries, including introducing new laws if necessary.

title: General : JKM To Review Long-term Care Arrangement For Late NorhazwaniÃ¢ÂÂs Daughters
summary: TUMPAT, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- The Kelantan Social Welfare Department (JKM) is reviewing long-term care arrangements for the two daughters of the late Norhazwani Ibrahim, a Malaysian Border Control and Protection Agency (AKPS) officer who was believed to have been murdered by her husband in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, on Oct 15.

title: General : Queen Donates 500,000 Face Masks To Johor Schoolchildren
summary: JOHOR BAHRU, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- Her Majesty Raja Zarith Sofiah, Queen of Malaysia, today donated face masks to the Johor state government for distribution to schoolchildren across the state.

title: General : Govt To Study Feasibility Of Expanding Implementation Of EKYC Verification To Online Gaming Platforms - Fahmi
summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- The government will examine the feasibility of expanding the implementation of electronic Know Your Customer (eKYC) verification and age verification to online gaming platforms such as Roblox, said Communications Minister Datuk Seri Fahmi Fadzil.

title: General : Two PWD Children Of Kuala Kangsar Murder Victim Still Housed At JKM Institution
summary: IPOH, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- Two persons with disabilities (PwDs), the children of a murder victim in Kampung Cheh Hilir, Kuala Kangsar, last month, are still being housed at a Perak Social Welfare Department (JKM) institution.

title: General : TXA2026: Focuses On Modernsiation Of Passenger Travel Processes, Decarbonisation Strategies
summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- The modernisation of passenger travel processes in the aviation sector using digital identity and biometrics, as well as decarbonisation strategies for the transportation sector, will be among the main focuses of the Transport Expo Asia (TXA) 2026 programme, which officially begins at the Malaysia International Trade and Exhibition Centre (MITEC) tomorrow.

title: World : Woman Killed, 13 Injured After 6-Vehicle Collision Near Tokyo
summary: YOKOHAMA, Oct 19 (Bernama-Kyodo) -- A 77-year-old woman died and 13 other people were injured on Monday in a six-vehicle collision involving a tour bus in Kanagawa Prefecture near Tokyo, local authorities said, Kyodo News reported.

title: Business : Malaysia Records Highest Economic Freedom Score Since 1970 - CME
summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 19 (Bernama) -- Malaysia recorded a score of 7.57 out of 10 in the ‘Economic Freedom of the World: 2026 Annual Report’, marking its strongest performance since the index was introduced in 1970, according to the Center for Market Education (CME).
